Waihopai Winter 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

This is the first competition in New Zealand to host dual rounds, meaning that all compeitors will advance to the second round of each event, and the winner/ranking of each round will be determined by the best result of each competitor across the two rounds.
